SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
SECOND SUPPLEMENTARY FINANCIAL STATEMENT
Authorization

I, do hereby grant Permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council todisburse as per the second supplementary financial statement for the year 2018, by virtue of powers vested in me underSection 27 (a) of the provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of theDemocratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Twenty Nine Billion Six Hundred andSeventy Million Nine Hundred and Forty Thousand Only (Rs. 29,670,940,000.00) for the service of the period beginning on01st of January, 2018 and ending 31st December, 2018, which is specified in annual financial statement - 2018 is hereby amendedas, Rupees Thirty Billion Five Hundred and Forty Two Million Two Thousand only (Rs. 30,542,002,000.00) and grant permissionto disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2018 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoningthe 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Councilwhich occurs first.
NILUKA EKANAYAKE,Honourable Governor,Sabaragamuwa Province.
24th day of July, 2018.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

GRANTING PERMISSION BY VIRTUE OF POWERS VESTED IN ME UNDER SECTION 27(A) OFPROVINCIAL COUNCIL ACT, No. 42 OF 1987 AS THE TERM OF THE SIXTH SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIALCOUNCIL OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA ENDED ON 26TH SEPTEMBER, 2017.
1. This permission may be cited as ‘‘ Permission to disburse under second financial statement - 2018 of the SabaragamuwaProvincial Council’’ and come into operation from 24.07.2018.

2. The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Twenty Nine Billion Six Hundredand Seventy Million Nine Hundred and Forty Thousand only (Rs. 29,670,940,000.00) for the service of the periodbeginning on 01st of January, 2018 and ending 31st December, 2018, which is specified in 2nd paragraph of GazetteNotification No. 2052/15 dated 03.01.2018 is hereby amended as, Rupees Thirty Billion Five Hundred and Forty TwoMillion , Two Thousand Only, (Rs. 30,542,002,000.00) and grant permission to Chief Secretary of this Province and otherAccounting Officers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.
Accordingly the first schedule of the said Gazette notification is amended as the first schedule hereof and grantpermission to disburse the same.

3. Advanced accounts limits which is specified in second schedule of Gazette Notification No. 2052/15 dated 03.01.2018 ishereby amended as second schedule of this notification and grant permission to Chief Secretary of this Province andother Accounting Officers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.

4. This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2018 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date ofsummoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of theSabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs first.
